## Version number
- Provide the version number of your branch, which would be the new master version number. Version numbers are structured like so:
- Major update : Minor update : Patch
- 3.2.1 is the 1st patch of the 2nd minor update of the 3rd major update.

## Description
Provide a brief description of the changes included in this pull request. Mention the purpose of the changes, the issues it addresses (if any), and any additional context.

## Changes Made
- List the changes made in this pull request.
- Bullet points are encouraged for clarity.
- For specific changes, please include the file name and purpose.

## Related Issues
- Use the `fixes #` keyword to link this pull request to an issue. For example:
  - Fixes #<issue-number>
  - Resolves #<issue-number>
  - Closes #<issue-number>

## Testing
- Include instructions for testing your changes.
- Mention any specific files, commands, or scenarios that need to be tested.

## Checklist
Please ensure the following requirements are met before merging:
- [ ] All unit tests have passed. (Wait for the unit test status check to pass.)
- [ ] At least one reviewer has approved the changes.
- [ ] All conversations in the review process have been resolved.
- [ ] Code adheres to the project's coding standards and guidelines.

## Additional Notes
(Optional) Include any additional information or suggestions for the reviewers.

---

### Contribution Guidelines Reminder:
1. **Wait for unit test status check**: Ensure all unit tests pass before merging the pull request.
2. **Approval requirement**: A minimum of **one approver** is needed to approve this pull request before it can be merged.
3. **Follow general project guidelines**: Ensure code quality and maintainability throughout.

Thank you for your contribution!
